description: Set a flex layout container's direction, wrapping, alignment, gaps, padding and sizing, and how its items size (Object > Flex Layout). Needs InDesign 2026 (21.0) or later.

items.description: Sizing for individual items in the containers

height.description: Height of the item: fixed, fill the space, or fit its content (auto)

width.description: Width of the item: fixed, fill the space, or fit its content (auto)

layout.description: Flex layout settings (Object > Flex Layout); only the ones you pass change

alignContent.description: How wrapped lines share extra space across the direction

alignItems.description: How items line up across the direction

height.description: Height of the container: fixed, fill the space, or hug its items (auto)

justifyContent.description: How items share space along the direction

width.description: Width of the container: fixed, fill the space, or hug its items (auto)

wrap.description: Keep the items on one line, or wrap them onto more lines

target.description: The flex containers (ids from create_flex_layout or get_flex_layout)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_flex_layout
title: Set Flex Layout
